scientific_question: Does the original E9 Newtonian-gauge d(delta_ncdm-delta_cdm)/dz reconstructed relative-wind proxy agree in magnitude/sign and R16 normalization with pinned CLASS vTk theta_ncdm-theta_cdm for frozen FD Fplus Fminus? Construct the direct-transfer long cb density-LOS relative-wind cross kernel, but DO NOT combine with E11 Gamma absent wind-rank compatibility.

CLASS_conventions.raw_transfer_normalization: unit primordial curvature R; t species are theta divergence transfer raw, units 1/Mpc in c=1 conventions, NOT km/s
CLASS_conventions.v_relative_per_primordial_curvature_tran: -c_kms*(t_ncdm[0]-t_cdm)/K_Mpc. Sign is a fixed definition and is reported, not selected by results.
CLASS_conventions.delta_cb_transfer: (omega_b*d_b+omega_cdm*d_cdm)/(omega_b+omega_cdm), Newtonian gauge, not directly galaxy bias
CLASS_conventions.signed_P_cb_r_over_i_mu_long_Mpc3: [c_kms/K_Mpc]*P_R_3D*delta_cb*theta_relative/sigma_LOS_direct for <delta_cb v_LOS^*>, where v_LOS=-i*mu*c_kms*theta_rel/K_Mpc*R. Report sign with this exact Fourier convention. P_Dr(K,mu)=i*mu*reported_real_coefficient.
CLASS_conventions.CLASS_metric_CDM_continuity: theta_cdm=H_CLASS(z)*d(d_cdm)/dz+3*phi_prime under Newtonian convention IF metric phi_prime is returned in the same CLASS transfer output; otherwise report metric unavailable and do not claim closure. Full ncdm continuity has extra pressure/metric terms; theta_rel may differ from density derivative.

locked_E12_geometry.original_E9_CLASS_params: Use code/wake_two_tracer_fisher.class_params with original frozen q distribution, base.ZBINS=[0.9,1.0], output=mPk,dTk,vTk, no precision changes
locked_E12_geometry.interpolation: np.interp only if CLASS k-grid covers both KVEL and K_LONG, fail closed on extrapolation
locked_E12_geometry.CDM_check: Print normalized residual theta_cdm-H*d(delta_cdm)/dz-3phi_prime when metric available, no after-the-fact sign selection or k² renormalization
locked_E12_geometry.E9_proxy_reproduction: At z=.95 reconstruct E9 direct baseline density-derived sigma on original KVEL, compare archived state vLOS with original .004 step. Report both levels .004 and .002.
locked_E12_geometry.direct_sigma: R16 top-hat original filter and trapezoidal dlnK integral original 180 grid, original kUpper=.1, sigma_LOS_direct=sqrt(integral (c*theta_rel/K)^2 primordialDelta² W² dlnK /3)
locked_E12_geometry.output: Separate unrounded signed direct theta and E9 density-proxy transfer arrays at four preregistered K_LONG, direct/proxy R16 sigma for all 3 states, optional phi_prime CDM continuity residual and 3 original-source direct P_(delta_cb,r)_over_i_mu real coefficients [Mpc³] in Newtonian gauge.
